text:
maria_finance: Heads-up — Acquirer just opened a reversal on invoice INV-98723 for CloudWare Inc. They marked it as 'services not rendered' and 'unauthorized'. Need an evidence packet by EOD, acquirer window is tight.

billing-bot: Automated alert: CHARGEBACK_OPEN ch_3Kq9zXxY amount=12500.00 currency=USD reason=services_not_rendered open_ts=1962104800

sam_support: I'm on ticket #5421 — customer acknowledged the upgrade and provided billing email 2026-03-18. I can paste the transcript and copy the support agent notes.

alex_fraud: Quick triage: IP and device fingerprint match previous paid sessions, AVS returned 'Y', CVV present at auth. No obvious proxy flagged. Recommend we submit: invoice PDF, charge auth, support transcript, session logs, and any delivery/usage evidence.

jordan_ops: Can we pull S3 access logs / usage metering for the account for Mar 15-20? Also need webhook delivery receipts (billing webhook) and invoice PDF with line items.

maria_finance: I'll assemble. Adding the key txn details here for the packet:

```
Charge ID: ch_3Kq9zXxY
Invoice: INV-98723
Amount: $12,500.00
Customer: CloudWare Inc (acct cw-8843)
Card: **** **** **** 1234
Auth code: 045612
Acquirer claim: 'services not rendered' / unauthorized
Open reason: services_not_rendered
Open ts: 1962104800
```

olivia_legal: Will review once you upload. We usually need: timestamped user consent (TOU checkbox), invoice, proof of service (usage logs or report), support ticket transcript, payment auth, and any email correspondence. Also confirm redaction of PII in recordings.

maria_finance: Checklist I'm preparing before upload: [x] invoice PDF, [x] charge auth, [x] support transcript, [ ] session recordings (redacting), [x] webhook receipts, [x] S3/usage CSV, [x] TOS acceptance screenshot. ETA 2h. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

billing-bot: Reminder — acquirer evidence window: 72 hours from dispute open. Current time left: ~48 hours.

alex_fraud: Also include risk flags: device reuse history, prior chargebacks (none), country mismatch (billing country = US, auth IP = US), shipping not applicable (digital). I'll add a short narrative describing how service was delivered and why claim seems unfounded.

sam_support: Pasting ticket excerpt (redacted):
> user: "We upgraded to Pro on Mar 18, saw immediate quota increase, confirmed billed."
> agent: "Confirmed charge on 03/18, invoice INV-98723 attached."

jordan_ops: Uploaded usage CSV to internal bucket: s3://redwood-disputes/INV-98723/usage_2026-03-15-20.csv

maria_finance: Uploading evidence to disputes dashboard now: https://console.redwood.inference/disputes/INV-98723 — tagging @olivia_legal and @alex_fraud. Will follow up if acquirer pushes for more.

olivia_legal: Thanks — if they litigate, we'll need full chain-of-custody for logs. For now this looks like a complete packet. Proceed to submit.

maria_finance: Submitted. Please ack here when you've added any missing redactions or notes. :thumbsup:
